text: Saramati (Burmese: စာရာမေတိတောင်; IPA: [ˌsæɹəˈmɑːti]) is a peak at an altitude of 2,885 metres (9,465 ft) on the border between the Indian state of Nagaland and the Naga Self-Administered Zone of the Sagaing Region of Myanmar. On the Indian side, the Naga village of Thanamir in Kiphire District lies at its foot.
best_time: October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala)
